verdict.rationale: Internal comments and @mentions beside a message are a fair question for an email inbox product, so the axis applies. AgentMail's evidence covers only adjacent features: cc/bcc of humans, draft review before sending, and labels for tracking conversation state. None of these is an internal comment side-thread with @mentions, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
